title: Reduce header brand text size on mobile

requirements.text: Update the selected header brand text element (/html/body/div/div/header/div/button/div/span) to use a smaller font size on mobile so the text fits without overflowing, while keeping the existing desktop sizing and styling.

quotes: decrease the size of the text , it not fit well in mobile version

acceptanceCriteria: On small/mobile viewports, the header brand text no longer overflows the header width or causes layout issues.
On desktop viewports (md and up), the brand text remains at the current visual size (equivalent to the existing text-2xl appearance).
Only the selected element’s text sizing is changed; no other header elements (nav, buttons, menu toggle) are modified.

constraints: Apply changes ONLY to the selected element at XPath /html/body/div/div/header/div/button/div/span (the brand text span in SiteHeader).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change the brand text content.
Do not redesign the header layout or navigation behavior.
Do not add new pages, routes, or backend changes.
